verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developers.mailersend.com, and a second llms.txt at www.mailersend.com indexes product and API documentation with descriptive entries an agent can follow. That satisfies the core of pointing an agent at llms.txt. However, per-page markdown docs (.md) return 404 and no OpenAPI spec is discoverable at the probed paths. missing for 10: markdown-rendered doc pages, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, an llms-full.txt or deeper agent-oriented guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
